content: Interns at Adobe are eligible for national holidays, global wellbeing days, Employee Assistance Programme (1to1help - 12 free sessions per issue), Headspace for meditation, Thrive Global for healthy habits, and onsite facilities like gym, cafeteria, and general physicians.

Apprentices get 10 days Sick/Casual leave, 8 days Casual leave, and 15 days Vacation leave per year. The 2026 Winter Break is from 24 December to 1 January (requires manager approval and Workday application).

Apprentices are covered under Group Health Insurance (₹7,00,000 for hospitalisation) and Group Personal Accident Insurance (₹40,00,000 flat cover). GPA nominees must be submitted within 15 days of joining on the MAven portal.
For queries, use the Employee Resource Centre Support Centre or contact the Apprenticeship Program Team via email.
